verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Termius converts a plain-language description into a shell command using AI (termius-docs-6). A separate FAQ page about the AI widget repeats this (termius-docs-45), so the capability is clearly documented and delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detail on how the AI generation works (model, context awareness, review or edit before execution, platform or plan availability), and independent or hands-on corroboration — no community item mentions the AI command feature.
